Advance Deposit, Processing Fee and Credit Card Fee:
A deposit of 20% (the "Advance Deposit") of the Minimum Spend will be charged at the time of booking. In addition to the Advance Deposit, non-refundable processing and credit card fees will also be charged at the time of booking. The Advance Deposit will be applied towards guest's final bill on the Booking Date. At time of check-in on the Booking Date, guests will be required to present the same method of payment as used when booking online or will be required to provide an alternative method of payment for their table/location.

All bookings will be charged the following on the Booking Date:

* Actual Spend: Guest will be charged the balance of the Actual Spend.

* Sales Tax: Guest will be charged sales tax, which is currently 8.375% and subject to change, on the Actual Spend + Venue Fee.

* Gratuity: Guest will be charged a waitress gratuity of 15%.

* Venue Fee: Guest will be charged a venue fee of 14% of the Actual Spend.

profile.name: Kaskade
profile.bio:
Ryan Raddon, known as Kaskade, is a household name in electronic music. He's a Multi GRAMMY Award-nominated musician and has a list of achievements any industry member couldn't dare dream of achieving in a dozen lifetimes. Kaskade has twelve studio albums and seven Grammy nominations. He was the first solo electronic dance artist to sell out both Navy Pier in Chicago (his hometown), and the Staples Center in Los Angeles (his home now). Kaskade was also the first DJ to secure a Las Vegas residency, creating the landscape for the city's future entertainment structure. He was the first electronic artist to headline Coachella; and has the honor to be the only DJ to have played the Grand Canyon West Skywalk. To date, Kaskade is the only musician to conceptualize and create an entire season of music for video game giant Rocket League and headlined multiple live streams during quarantine including a Fornite feature concert. In July of 2021, Kaskade came out of quarantine swinging as the first ever solo headlining musician to sell out and perform for a public event at LA's SoFi Stadium.

Kaskade has a fanbase nothing short of evangelical. With collaborations under his belt with heavy hitters Alicia Keys, Jennifer Lopez, Gwen Stefani and Meghan Trainor, he has the unique talent of creating his signature sound in any genre. Most recently Kaskade has teamed up with fellow producer deadmau5 to form Kx5. Their debut single "Escape" has cracked the Top 40 and in this year has been the #1 Dance Single on Mediabase charts.Stay tuned for more moves from the original curve bender, Kaskade.
